articles.title: Iran widens Gulf attacks, firing on a US air base in Kuwait and at targets in Bahrain
articles.description: Iran has widened its attacks on Gulf neighbors, targeting a U.S. air base in Kuwait following American strikes on an Iranian missile site. Kuwait says its defenses intercepted drones while Bahrain issued two shelter alerts. Saudi Arabia also intercepted a cruise missile fired by Iran-backed Houthi rebels in Yemen, following Saudi-led airstrikes that the Houthis say killed at least 17 people. The attacks raise fears of escalation as Iran faces mounting economic pressure from a U.S. naval blockade and continued military confrontation over the Strait of Hormuz.
